steps.title: Step 2 · Fill in
steps.instructions: Word bank (one word is not used): cafeteria · freshman · group project · tuition fee · study group · campus

items.label: 1. Our ____ has a big library and two cafés.
2. I'm in a ____ with four friends. We meet on Tuesdays.
3. The ____ is 12 million đồng a year.
4. I'm a ____. This is my first year at university.
5. Our ____ is about pollution. Each person writes one part.
